blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven current renders after adding the four-edge shorts gusset. In crouch and sit, gray avatar surface remains visible along the upper inner thighs; crouch still has a pronounced triangular inner-thigh opening. The gusset does not provide continuous thigh coverage. No measured fit, opacity or Shape Key acceptance.

Front, side and rear views show a broad, nearly plain bell-like overskirt with uneven angular folds. In crouch and sit the hem and rear panels bunch into wide sheet-like folds behind and between the legs; pleat structure is not clear. No visual acceptance.

The arms-up and arm-cross views retain dense faceting and heavy wrinkles across sleeve caps and underarm transitions. The neck opening remains a tall exposed cylindrical collar rim. Surface flow and collar finish require further work.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
